title: WAF: Bot Traffic
description: Bot traffic through the frontend WAFs, from AWS/WAFV2 CloudWatch metrics in us-east-1. Production only. No template variables: Grafana does not interpolate them into CloudWatch dimension values, so every WebACL is named literally. Denominator is AllowedRequests{Rule=ALL}, which equals total traffic only because no rule in these ACLs blocks; if a blocking rule is added, BlockedRequests{Rule=ALL} must be added to it.

panels.title: cpr: bot share of traffic (%)
panels.description: Bot requests as a percentage of all requests on cpr. Read the trend, not a point value: a spike in ordinary traffic pushes this down without bot traffic changing at all, so check the request-count panels below before concluding anything. Reads zero before 2026-07-22, when the bot rule reached production.
